sandbox_teardown: mid-drive, after a single click on the shell's LOCALHOST PORTS disclosure control (pane_click_ax ref 24, which reported nav_in_progress), the supplied sandbox binding (window=main-8, mode=solu-accept-a5a0bee4, pane_index=0) became entirely unavailable. It no longer appears in mcp__solubrowse__list_panes, and every subsequent call against it (get_pane_url, pane_wait_nav) returned the error "unknown mode 'solu-accept-a5a0bee4'". The sandbox could not be recovered for the remainder of the run, so no further evidence (including a persisted screenshot of the shell state) could be captured.
